blurb.text: A large region of the Western Cape containing Paarl, Stellenbosch, Swartland, Constantia and Franschhoek. Plantings across Paarl, Swartland and Stellenbosch are led by Chenin Blanc, Cabernet Sauvignon and Shiraz.
